issues.text: The next bullet names a "data layer" (DonHang.Infrastructure, holding DonHangDbContext and EfOrderRepository), and s4 says DIP runs "between two layers": business and data. Now that bullet 1 is the "repository layer", I pause: is it a third layer or another name for the data layer? And is IOrderRepository, which lives in DonHang.Domain, in it? I can still follow the main idea.
issues.quote: each class in it is a repository.
issues.fix: Add one clause to bullet 1, e.g. "; in Đơn Hàng its classes live in the data layer, behind the `IOrderRepository` interface", so the reader knows how the repository layer relates to the data layer.

issues.text: The question asks what the class is ("a ____", answer "repository"), but the explanation then calls it "the layer". Bullet 1 just taught me the class is a repository and the layer is the repository layer, so the explanation mixes the two right where the lesson separates them.
issues.quote: Repository — the layer that hides how orders are fetched and saved behind four methods.
